metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2015 · Jonathan Strange & Mr Norrell
metas.description: In an alternate history, during the time of real life Napoleonic Wars, two men of destiny, the gifted recluse Mr. Norrell and daring spellcasting novice Jonathan Strange, use magic to help England.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2019 · Greatest Events of WWII in Colour
metas.description: A series of colorized archive footage of important events during World War II.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2018 · Das Boot
metas.description: An inexperienced U-boat crew has to survive a secret mission and a young German woman is torn between loyalty for her home country and the French resistance in this WWII drama.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2016 · Roots
metas.description: An adaptation of Alex Haley's "Roots" chronicles the history of an African man and his descendants sold into slavery in America.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2015 · The Heavy Water War: Stopping Hitler's Atomic Bomb
metas.description: The story behind Germany's attempt to develop an atomic bomb during World War II and the sabotage of the heavy water program in Rjukan, Norway from the points of view of the Germans, the Allies, the saboteurs, and the company.
